title: Introducing Anima Referrals
summary: The August 2026 pilot announcement for Anima Referrals: drafting Advice & Guidance and referrals from the consultation and patient record.
body_markdown:
We introduced Anima Referrals on 20 August 2026 as an upcoming product, with an invitation for practices to join the pilot. It is designed to reduce the administrative work between a consultation and a referral.


[Watch the Referrals introduction](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7496188680357736449/)


## From consultation to referral


The announced workflow uses the Scribe consultation and patient record to draft Advice & Guidance and referrals, drawing on national and local guidelines. It is designed to help clinicians prepare the information and send it to the appropriate service.


## One worklist for follow-up work


Our September update describes a shared worklist for referrals, documents and appointments, with Advice & Guidance handled in the same place. Referrals can be sent to e-RS and saved to the electronic health record.


The aim is to reduce time spent drafting and checking referrals while keeping the practice’s oversight of what has been sent.


[Explore Anima Referrals](https://www.animahealth.com/products/secondary/referrals)


[Ask about the Referrals pilot](https://www.animahealth.com/contact/sales)
